gui.statecraft.claimmap.already_claimed: This land is already claimed. Nations can claim only unclaimed chunks.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.dimension_change: Dimension changed; the previous chunk selection was cleared.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.ineligible_cell: Not selectable in this government context

gui.statecraft.claimmap.no_targets: No eligible targets. Check permissions or create a child government, then refresh.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.no_unclaimed: No unclaimed chunks in view. Move or zoom out.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.request_failed: Could not request server choices. Reconnect or refresh; nothing was submitted.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.search_help: Choose a name. Scroll for more entries on this page.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.select_hint: Select chunks, then review. Clicking never submits.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.selection_unknow: Some selections lack current territory data. Move closer or clear them.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.session_changed: Session changed. Reopen the map from your government.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.target_hint: Search server-eligible targets. Unassigned clears this allocation.

gui.statecraft.claimmap.timeout: Server choices did not arrive. Refresh to retry; nothing was submitted.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.zoom_in_hint: Show fewer, larger chunks. The map follows you.
gui.statecraft.claimmap.zoom_out_hint: Show more surrounding chunks, up to eight in each direction.
